scripts.release:verify: npm run lint && npm run test:critical && npm run build && npm run verify:release-artifacts && npm run verify:function-security && npm run verify:android-config && npm run functions:build
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && npx cap sync android && npm run verify:android-config
scripts.firebase:deploy:functions: npm run functions:build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only functions --project inkbound-app
scripts.firebase:deploy:security: npm run functions:build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:rules,storage,functions --project inkbound-app
scripts.firebase:deploy:web: npm run verify:production-env && npm run release:verify && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project inkbound-app
scripts.firebase:deploy:all: npm run verify:production-env && npm run release:verify && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,storage,functions --project inkbound-app
